title: Уступка Нагиева и новый план Макса  (Nagiyev Yields the Table and Max's New Plan)

segments.t: Hearing that Barinov invited Elena Pavlovna on a date, Nagiyev good-naturedly yields his lucky table and moves to another spot with Kristina. Back in the kitchen, Senya refuses to give Max any more hair, and Max quotes Sun Tzu on knowing the enemy to defeat Ilya.
Ну, ладно, отдыхай.
Счастливый столик.
Обязательно что-нибудь вечером тебе отломится.
Я-то с женой.
Пойду сяду за столик для плебеев.
Спасибо тебе.
До свидания.
Больше волос не дам.
Да не нужны мне твои волосы.
А что на этот раз?
Как ты на этот раз хочешь подставить Илью?
Знай своего врага лучше, чем самого себя.
И победа будет неизбежна.
Let's replay the exchange and look closely at each Russian phrase.
Ну, ладно, отдыхай.
'Well, alright, enjoy your evening.' Around the shift and table, Ilya sets a calm, everyday tone with Senya.
Счастливый столик.
'It is a lucky table.' Since it is a lucky table, Senya does not waste words on excuses.
Обязательно что-нибудь вечером тебе отломится.

'You are guaranteed to get lucky tonight.' Mentioning that Senya is guaranteed to get lucky tonight moves the talk in a new direction. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
Я-то с женой.
'Whereas I am dining with my wife.' Senya reminds Ilya that whereas he is dining with his wife before the moment passes.
Пойду сяду за столик для плебеев.
'I will go sit at a table for commoners.' Because he will go sit at a table for commoners, Ilya treats the matter as settled.
Спасибо тебе.
'Thank you, Dima.' With the moment and table in play, Senya keeps this short reply brisk and direct. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
До свидания.
'See you later.' Telling Senya to see Senya later is how Ilya lays out the situation for Senya.
Больше волос не дам.
'I am not giving you any more hair.' Because he is not giving Ilya any more hair, Senya treats the matter as settled.
Да не нужны мне твои волосы.

'I do not need your hair anymore.' Explaining that he does not need Senya's hair anymore lays the cards on the table for Senya. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
А что на этот раз?
'So what is the plan this time?' Wondering what the plan this time is is how Senya puts Ilya on the spot.
Как ты на этот раз хочешь подставить Илью?

'How are you planning to set Ilya up this time?' Here wondering how Senya planning to set Ilya up this time is shows Ilya looking for the real truth. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
Знай своего врага лучше, чем самого себя.
'Know your enemy better than you know yourself.' Noting that Ilya should know Ilya's enemy better than Ilya knows themselves keeps Senya's side of the story simple and clear.
И победа будет неизбежна.
'And victory will be inevitable.' Even though victory will be inevitable, Ilya keeps a steady face in front of Senya. Let's hear the complete conversation once more.

Знай своего врага лучше, чем самого себя.
И победа будет неизбежна.
That wraps up this scene as nagiyev graciously lets Barinov keep the lucky table for his date with Elena, while Fedya asks Max how he plans to set Ilya up next. Until next time!
Хорошего дня!
